profit_quality.assessment: Reported profit converts well into statutory operating cash flow, but the business then spends very large cash amounts on capitalised copyrights. 2024 operating cash flow was RMB292.241 million, while additions to intangible assets were RMB409.309 million; 2023 showed the same pattern. The owner-earnback denominator is therefore the 2022-2024 median parent profit of RMB81.851 million, discounted by 65%.
adjustments: Used 2022-2024 median parent net profit as the pre-haircut sustainable profit: median of RMB37.537 million, RMB145.167 million and RMB81.851 million equals RMB81.851 million.
Did not add back amortisation as distributable cash because annual copyright additions materially exceeded amortisation.
Applied profit haircut factor 0.35 due to repeated negative cash flow after capitalised content additions and incomplete maintenance/growth capex split.
Tax overprovision reversal of RMB8.869 million and convertible-bond fair value gain of RMB0.246 million were treated as quality issues within the haircut rather than separate recurring earnings.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 OCF/net profit was 3.57x, but OCF minus intangible additions was RMB-117.068 million; 2023 OCF minus intangible additions was RMB-119.120 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Large capitalised content additions make accounting profit a weak proxy for distributable owner cash.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Statutory operating cash conversion is strong, but operating cash flow is not free cash flow because online-guide content additions are capitalised in investing cash flow.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: RMB113.925 million amortisation is used as a floor signal for maintenance content consumption; actual 2024 copyright cash additions were RMB409.309 million and not split between maintenance and growth.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital released cash, so no extra working-capital reinvestment deduction was taken in the main denominator.
